name: Karra Elejalde
bio:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Carlos Elejalde Garai (born 10 October 1960 in Vitoria-Gasteiz) is a Spanish actor. He has appeared in more than forty films since 1987.

credits.title: The Child
credits.overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

credits.title: Collision Course
credits.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

credits.title: Arriba Tutto
credits.overview: A seven-year-old boy's magical childhood with his street performer father ends tragically. Years later, he struggles with anger and bitterness, having lost the joy and wonder he once knew.

credits.title: Las Hijas
credits.overview: A twenty-year-old girl wakes up in a house in the woods after a night of partying. Three young women greet her as the daughters of her kidnapper. They too were kidnapped, and their isolation led them to embrace this community as idyllic.

credits.title: Auri
credits.overview: Auri's life takes a sudden turn when she receives her first earnings and, for the first time, experiences a new kind of freedom.

credits.title: The One-Minute Problem
credits.overview: When a Spanish immigrant who's trying to invent teleportation in his garage sucks too much power from the electrical grid, a Department of Water and Power inspector vows to shut him down, putting both his invention and his relationship with his pregnant wife at risk.

credits.title: The Gentleman
credits.overview: Aging ex-soldier Theo meets weekly with prostitute Olga to reminisce. After Olga's murder, Theo seeks bloody revenge, attracting attention of alcoholic cop Iborra and hitman Herodes.

credits.title: Barren Land
credits.overview: Barren Land is the story of three friends. All three trapped between the abandonment of the institutions, the violent and unstoppable rise of the narco in the province and the dangerous increase of social discontent. Three friends trapped in a powder keg that will test their friendship.

credits.title: Speak Sunlight
credits.overview: Set majorly Pamplona in 1965, follows the life of American writer Alan Jolis as he awakes to a vivid sensual world and grows up emotionally.

credits.title: Yegua
credits.overview: In the heart of Navarra, in the Valdorba mountains, a small town survives depopulation by coping with everyday problems. credits.title: The Three Wise Men vs. Santa
credits.overview: The Three Wise Men, fed up with Santa taking more and more prominence from them, have decided to confront each other without knowing that this war will awaken a much more dangerous common enemy, the Krampus, who had been inactive for centuries.

credits.title: Vasil
credits.overview: Vasil is a Bulgarian immigrant who lives on the street in Spain. Intelligent and charismatic, he has an amazing talent for chess and bridge, so much so, in fact, that despite being homeless, he manages to make a name for himself in an exclusive and prestigious club in the city.

credits.title: Two Many Chefs
credits.overview: Mikel, a young cook, meets with his father Juan, who had been missing for 30 years. While trying to keep his restaurant afloat, Mikel has to take care of crazed Juan, a former cook who suffers from a mental condition that prevents him from recognizing neither the aforementioned time gap nor his son Mikel.

credits.title: What Lucia Saw
credits.overview: During a night of 1989, in the middle of the Salvadoran civil war, six Jesuit priests were murdered at the UCA University. credits.title: Below Zero
credits.overview: When a prisoner transfer van is attacked, the cop in charge must fight those inside and outside while dealing with a silent foe: the icy temperatures.

credits.title: While at War
credits.overview: Salamanca, Spain, 1936. In the early days of the military rebellion that began the Spanish Civil War (1936-39), writer Miguel de Unamuno supports the uprising in the hope that the prevailing political chaos will end. But when the confrontation becomes bloody, Unamuno must question his initial position.

credits.title: The Little Switzerland
credits.overview: The discovery of the tomb of William Tell’s son in a town in the Basque Country spurs the village's cantankerous citizens to lobby for Swiss annexation.

credits.title: Holy Goalie
credits.overview: A young priest coaches a team of uncoordinated monks in order to win a soccer tournament and save their monastery from being turned into a hotel.

credits.title: The Bastards' Fig Tree
credits.overview: A trigger-happy Nationalist fears retribution from the son of a man he executed. credits.title: Operation Golden Shell
credits.overview: A con artist owner of a bankrupt film company tries to lure in an investor by hiring a movie star's look-alike and passing him off as the real deal.

credits.title: 1898: Our Last Men in the Philippines
credits.overview: The Philippines, 1898. Fifty Spanish soldiers arrive in the small village of Baler to rebuild an outpost. Although the war against the Filipinos and their American allies is almost lost, as is the Spanish Empire, the garrison will endure a cruel siege for eleven months. They will be the last to surrender.

credits.title: 100 Meters
credits.overview: Based on the incredibly true story of a Spanish man with Multiple Sclerosis who tried to finish an Iron-Man: 3,8km swimming, 180km cycling and 42 running. And he was told that he could not make 100 meters.

credits.overview: During a long night of August, some people have different experiences that leave a deep impression in them. Linked by a radio night show, all them cross the city of Barcelona, not knowing that their fates will collide with each other in unexpected ways.

credits.title: We Are Pregnant
credits.overview: It seems simple: an egg + sperm = one embryo. But if your sperm is "few, vague and abnormal" and your woman is premenopausal at age 37, things start to get complicated.

credits.overview: Amaia after breaking up with Rafa, falls in love with a Catalonian. Koldo, her father, goes to Sevilla to persuade Rafa to go to Catalonia and take Amaia's heart back.

credits.title: Rey gitano
credits.overview: Two unemployed detectives with conflicting ideologies meet a rogue and seductive gypsy who proposes them a crazy mission. After that, their luck will change for the worse.

credits.title: Loco con ballesta
credits.overview: Pedro and his son Javier go to the mountains to get mushrooms.

Once inside the asylum, Basilio will try to use all the skills of his trade to overcome the threats that keep him from reaching his goal.

credits.overview: The relationship that botanist Angel establishes in his mind between plants, their stems, petals and pistils and the legs and feet of women, is the common thread of a plot that mixes sexual passion, love, greed and picaresque through a study of characters and situations.

credits.overview: When American author Nicholas brings in a cosmetologist named Kika to prepare the corpse of his recently deceased son, she inadvertently revives the young man, then falls in love with him. Forces conspire against the couple, though, as Nicholas wants Kika for himself.

credits.title: The Red Squirrel

credits.title: Sauna
credits.overview: Two women meet in a sauna. The one, wife of an advertising creative, the other, a rock singer. The publicist, who works on sock ads, has a crazy mother. He is also crazy, by inheritance .
